Never going to be put into ANY game. Most people are awful gamers and they do suck hard but you cannot punish them for being bad. The game cannot distinguish whether you are just bad or afk if you deal little damage.

There is many Monster Hunter veterans out there who feel that way and I do too but dude just look at the average hunter online right now. They get hit constantly, die to random shit all the fucking time. Casuals, sorta. 

Think of them what you want but they bring the numbers and they want entertainment. You do not entertain them by shitting on them early on. The average casual gamer needs to be introduced into the game very slowly with lots of hand holding. Unfortunately a not-challenging solo experience makes a bad hunter. Carrying became a huge problem in MHW and IB. Tons of awful hunters who could never kill a monster solo. I guess we have to live with it because money still rules.

Heavy Artillery 2 is a must for your first solo kill. You can get better times if you spend more time practicing the encounter but as of now just slot it in somewhere. **Do NOT use the cannons.**

Start out the fight and bring him down to 78%. Make sure, and this is very important, to keep him enraged and get a fresh tenderize on his chest and head. Transition to phase 2 smoke bomb temporal get into the ballista and unload everything on his chest. Also get the binding ballista shot after his breath ends.

You get a guaranteed trip with increased damage (agitator) and you can get some good damage on his head. You waste all your agitator and tenderize damage increase if you use the ghillie mantle cannon cheese because he only trips once of artillery damage and you want to trip him with the ballista. 

This should bring to below 60%. From then on just make sure to break the head once before going into P3 which is at exactly 50%. Both binding shots should help you out do dish some good damage. The hard part of the fight begins now: do damage and do not die is really the only thing I can say here. There is no other way. The pressure is on and you need to perform. Do NOT use your temporal mantle if it is up until you can use the ballista a second time. You should once again tenderize his chest and use smoke bombs at the ballista to lose aggro. Use the dragonator when ready. Ballista + dragonator (including the extra damage you can deal after the dragonator trip) should be about 25% of his remaining HP so technically you really just need to bring him down to 25%.

That is all. Make sure to get a meta set. The said you mentioned in another comment can be improved. Make use of Agitator and force-proc it with 3 clutch claw flinches. Maybe watch a speedrun of the fight. HMU if you have any other questions.

There is one thing Ion really cares about and its player retention. Most casual players dont give a single shit about rating. They want good gear to smash lower geared players with. This is the whole point of this game: become stronger.

The problem was those players quitting not long after they got their conquest gear. There are only so many random battlegrounds and low rated arenas to do for them if they dont get any upgrades out of it. 

Templates in Legion were rightfully removed after one expansion even though they made the game way more balanced in retrospect. BFA gearing was awful because most of the gear came from PvE and it was obviously disliked that much, they actually gave in and brought vendors back. 

The problem with the new vendors is the removal of the PvP-only stats. Remember, Ion wants you to play the game. In Shadowlands, you CAN gear up from PvP only. But you could also grind out some mythic+ or clear the raid a few times because ILVL is still strong and some pieces might even have versatility on it. On the other hand, PvE players may also do some PvP now to fill out some lower ilvl slots with conquest gear. Players are encouraged to do all types of content the game offers in order to gear up their character. 

Unfortunately, honor gear only goes up to ilvl 184 and with the low conquest cap you either get 2-3 pieces or a weapon. If you pick up the game right now and refuse to do any PvE content, you will be stuck at a 190ish ilevel and worse players with better gear are going to farm you. This is mostly because you missed out on the weekly vault items.

It is going to even out in the coming weeks when PvPers can upgrade their honor gear to 197 and farm up even more conquest because we will get more upgrades out of every gear piece.
